name: ChargeChain SPKLU Revenue Token
description: CHRG is an asset-backed revenue-share token (Station Revenue Token / SRT) representing a claim on the operating margin of PLN's SPKLU electric-vehicle charging network in Indonesia. Backed by 329 revenue-generating stations (actual operational data, March 2026). Par value Rp 100,000, target yield 13%. Educational/simulation project — not an investment solicitation.
